quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.

text: Add a token by scanning a QR code or entering the service key manually
quote: Tap the “+” button in the app and scan the QR code or rewrite the service key manually and compare the results with the generated token.

text: Works offline and is free to use
quote: It's 100% free and works offline.

text: Can be used anonymously without creating an account
quote: 100% anonymous use. Download the app and start using it without any registration.

text: Apple Watch app for accessing codes

quote: The 2FAS Auth browser extension pairs with your phone to deliver 2FA tokens where you sign in — simple, private, and secure, without leaving the tab.

text: Click the extension icon and confirm in the mobile app to enter a 2FA token without retyping it
quote: Click the browser extension icon when you need to enter a 2FA token, then confirm in the mobile app. You don't have to retype anything.

text: Browser extensions available for Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Safari
quote: Add 2FAS Auth to your web browser by installing our extension for Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Safari.

quote: you can use the keyboard shortcut **Ctrl/CMD + Shift + 2**

text: 2FAS Pass offers three Security Tiers that control how each vault item is accessed
quote: Instead, they are retrieved from your mobile phone when needed, and you control how each is accessed using integrated Security Tiers.

quote: Access through the Browser Extension or using Autofill must be confirmed in 2FAS Pass.

quote: none of your Items are stored permanently in the browser's memory or on third-party servers. Instead, they are retrieved from your mobile phone when needed

quote: Auto-fill

text: Choose where vault data is stored: your own cloud or an encrypted file on an external drive
quote: You decide where to store your Items. You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.

quote: Use the following instructions if you have synchronized 2FAS Pass Vault with your WebDAV.

quote: 2FAS Share lets you share sensitive information end-to-end encrypted, with no account required, fully private and free to use.

text: Share items from the browser extension without needing the phone

text: Share selected passwords with the browser securely
quote: Share selected passwords with the browser securely and privately.
